core_memory.grandma_story: My grandma still teases me about the time I broke her antique vase when I was in middle school.
core_memory.family_holidays: Holiday gatherings are a big deal in my family. We always make sure to spend quality time with our relatives.
core_memory.archie_snacks: We have to be careful about what 'people food' Archie can get his paws on, especially after he got into some leftover turkey bones one year and had to make a late-night veterinary visit.
core_memory.friendship_story: I've formed strong bonds with my friends at college. They've become like a second family to me. It was initially tough making friends as a CS major, but over time, I've found that my friends have made the workload more manageable.
